# ==============================================================================
# Part C: Dynamic Anti-Hegemon Counter-Balancing Triggers (Slot 67 = heg, O(1))
# ==============================================================================

# Any scope: Dynamic anti-hegemon layer is enabled by Rule #10 and has an active cached hegemon.
oe_heg_ai_is_active = {
    NOT = { oe_rule_is_hegemon_ai_off = yes }
    has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_active
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_active }
        global_var:oe_heg_ai_active = 1
    }
    has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target
}

# Any scope: Cached global hegemon currently suffers High Entropy (oe_ent_index >= 60).
oe_heg_ai_hegemon_high_entropy = {
    has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_ent_high
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_ent_high }
        global_var:oe_heg_ai_ent_high = 1
    }
}

# Country scope: belongs to the 12 Great Powers roster (plus key regional coalition counterweights).
oe_heg_ai_is_major_12 = {
    OR = {
        tag = BYZ
        tag = ROM
        tag = TUR
        tag = CHI
        tag = GLH
        tag = MOS
        tag = RUS
        tag = FRA
        tag = HAB
        tag = CAS
        tag = SPA
        tag = MAM
        tag = POL
        tag = PLC
        tag = TIM
        tag = IRA
        tag = DLH
        tag = VIJ
        tag = ENG
        tag = GBR
        tag = MUG
        tag = BAH
    }
}

# Country scope: meets the dynamic hegemon threshold (Rule #10 standard=250/rr6, high=180/rr4).
oe_heg_ai_meets_threshold = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    is_subject = no
    OR = {
        AND = {
            NOT = { oe_rule_is_hegemon_ai_high = yes }
            OR = {
                num_locations >= 250
                AND = {
                    OR = {
                        tag = BYZ
                        tag = ROM
                    }
                    has_variable = oe_rr_count
                    trigger_if = {
                        limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_count }
                        var:oe_rr_count >= 6
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        AND = {
            oe_rule_is_hegemon_ai_high = yes
            OR = {
                num_locations >= 180
                AND = {
                    OR = {
                        tag = BYZ
                        tag = ROM
                    }
                    has_variable = oe_rr_count
                    trigger_if = {
                        limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_count }
                        var:oe_rr_count >= 4
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope: lies in the same macro-theater as the active cached hegemon.
oe_heg_ai_in_active_theater = {
    has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_theater
    OR = {
        AND = {
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_theater } global_var:oe_heg_ai_theater = 1 }
            oe_heg_ai_in_theater_1 = yes
        }
        AND = {
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_theater } global_var:oe_heg_ai_theater = 2 }
            oe_heg_ai_in_theater_2 = yes
        }
        AND = {
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_theater } global_var:oe_heg_ai_theater = 3 }
            oe_heg_ai_in_theater_3 = yes
        }
    }
}

# Country scope (target/peer check, scope-neutral): sovereign major in the threatened anti-hegemon circle.
oe_heg_ai_is_threatened_peer = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    is_subject = no
    oe_heg_ai_is_active = yes
    oe_heg_ai_is_major_12 = yes
    has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target }
        NOT = { global_var:oe_heg_ai_target ?= this }
        NOT = { is_subject_of = global_var:oe_heg_ai_target }
        NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = global_var:oe_heg_ai_target } }
        OR = {
            is_neighbor_of = global_var:oe_heg_ai_target
            oe_heg_ai_in_active_theater = yes
        }
        # Respect Franco-Roman Lily Accord (oe_weu_fra_pact = 1) when BYZ/ROM is the hegemon.
        NOT = {
            AND = {
                tag = FRA
                oe_weu_fra_pact_active = yes
                global_var:oe_heg_ai_target = {
                    OR = {
                        tag = BYZ
                        tag = ROM
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope (AI actor check): AI major actively counter-balancing the cached global hegemon.
oe_heg_ai_is_threatened_major = {
    is_ai = yes
    oe_heg_ai_is_threatened_peer = yes
}
